mandatory_action_summary: Main line shall be redesigned, resupported, or detailed dynamic stress analysis conducted (TM-09). Baseline vibration monitoring required (TM-07/08). Apply corrective actions (TM-10). All SBCs on line must be assessed (TM-03). Visual survey for geometry/support (TM-05/06).
Preventive redesign/resupport should be examined, or visual survey (TM-05) and vibration monitoring (TM-07) conducted. Assess all SBCs on the line (TM-03).
Visual survey (TM-05) to check for poor construction/geometry/support. SBC assessment if high consequence line.
No further action required under baseline operating envelope.
SBC shall be redesigned, resupported, or detailed FEA/dynamic analysis conducted (TM-11). Baseline vibration monitoring required (TM-07/08). Visual survey of all SBC and tubing geometries (TM-05/06).
SBC should be visually inspected (TM-05) and baseline vibration measurements taken (TM-07). Consider proactive bracing per TM-11.
No further action required unless subject to severe external excitation.
Modify thermowell (shorten insertion length, increase root diameter, or install velocity collar) or conduct detailed fluid-structure interaction analysis (TM-12).
